Emma — thanks for sending this over, the MAP looks like a solid starting point. A few things from our side I want to confirm so we have an actionable implementation plan embedded in the MAP: 

1) Canary approach and rollback criteria
- Proposed: 14-day canary with a staged ramp (Day 1–3: 1–2% traffic, Day 4–7: 5%, Day 8–14: 10%).
- Rollback triggers: p95 latency increase >40% vs baseline, error rate exceeding 0.5% sustained over 10m, or a regression on any guarded eval from the EvalPlan (smoke/function/perf).

2) Serving configuration (notes for Ben)
- We'll route canary traffic to a Dedicated pool (isolated GPUs) and enable prefix/KV caching for repeated queries.
- If capacity is constrained, automatic fallback will route to a lighter-weight model variant (same prompt surface) — this will be documented in the runbook.

3) Evaluation plan highlights
- Smoke tests: health checks and basic prompt/response validation (owner: Novacore QE)
- Functional: 50 curated prompts with pass thresholds on correctness and hallucination rate (owner: joint)
- Performance: 1k synthetic requests across peak window to validate p95 and cost targets (owner: Redwood infra)

4) Training & knowledge transfer
- We'll run two 90-minute live sessions (ops + devs) and record them; materials and a 1-page runbook will be provided.

Ben — can you confirm the Dedicated pool sizing assumptions and whether we need a short pre-canary soak on a staging cluster? Jordan — can you pick 2 dates for a kickoff between Oct 4–8?

I'll add a short draft MAP checklist back to your sheet once we align.

Best,
Grace Oconnor

- Performance (pass = p95 latency <200ms, token cost within target band) — run peak simulation during staging soak

Attachments: Deployment_Validation_Checklist.pdf (checklist + test cases)
